name: Crowley Puerto Plata Container Terminal - Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Crowley operates a weekly container service (Puerto Plata to Port Everglades) out of the Puerto Plata multipurpose port, addressed 'Antigua Via Ferrea, Muelle Nuevo'. The port is shared cargo + cruise: the long central pier is the Taino Bay cruise berth (3 cruise ships visible in imagery), and a private cruise village (circular structures, lagoon) sits on the east/landside. The CARGO/CONTAINER operation is the modest paved working yard on the WEST side of the pier base, near round bulk-storage tanks. There is no large dedicated container stacking yard like a major terminal; this is a small multipurpose wharf. Imagery was hard to disambiguate (cruise vs cargo); confidence is LOW.
fieldNotes.yardSpots: The 'yard spots' figure (trailerParkingCapacity ~250) is CONTAINER/CHASSIS GROUND SLOTS, not dock-door positions. It is a conservative estimate from the small west-side paved cargo yard; the dedicated container footprint is modest (~10-12 acres of working wharf/yard). Low confidence - the cargo area shares space with bulk/general cargo and bunker operations.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Marine container terminal - no warehouse dock-door bank visible in the cargo yard. dockDoorCount = 0; dockDoors band = NONE.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A controlled port-perimeter entry is expected at a working port (ISPS/security), and a guarded gate is implied, but the exact gate structure and lane count were NOT cleanly resolved in satellite (the port frontage abuts the cruise-village access). Flagged uncertain. Street View exists at the port frontage (pano @ 19.79832,-70.70121, captured 2022-03), so hasCoverage:true, but no specific gate pano id was locked - heading 30 points from the road toward the cargo yard.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: The cargo yard frontage is tight against the urban street grid of San Felipe de Puerto Plata; a truck queue would have little stacking room and could spill onto city streets.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur into the cargo yard (the address references 'Antigua Via Ferrea' = former railway, now abandoned). railServed:false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Downtown Puerto Plata - dense urban fabric immediately surrounds the port.
